key.name: ga-api-key
key.description: Service account credentials JSON content for Google Analytics

key.name: ga-property-id
key.description: The GA property/project ID to track

key.name: analytics-timezone
key.description: Timezone reported by Google Analytics Data API metadata

key.name: ga-project-name
key.description: Display name of the tracked project

key.name: credential-storage
key.description: Where to store service account credentials: gsettings or keyring

key.name: tmp-sign-data-path
key.description: Last temp file path used for in-memory signing data (for cleanup on crash)

key.name: panel-display
key.description: What to show in panel: live, daily, weekly, monthly, or nothing

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size in pixels for panel and menu icons

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh data in minutes (30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 720, 1440)

key.name: current-daily
key.description: Current day visitor count

key.name: current-live
key.description: Visitors in the most recent refresh window

key.name: today-live-peak
key.description: Highest live visitor count observed today

key.name: current-weekly
key.description: Current week visitor count

key.name: current-monthly
key.description: Current month visitor count

key.name: record-daily
key.description: Highest daily visitor count from completed periods

key.name: last-notified-daily
key.description: Last daily record value that triggered a notification

key.name: last-record-daily
key.description: Timestamp when the daily record was last updated

key.name: record-live
key.description: Highest live visitor count within a refresh window

key.name: last-notified-live
key.description: Last live record value that triggered a notification

key.name: last-record-live
key.description: Timestamp when the live record was last updated

key.name: record-weekly
key.description: Highest weekly visitor count from completed periods

key.name: last-notified-weekly
key.description: Last weekly record value that triggered a notification

key.name: last-record-weekly
key.description: Timestamp when the weekly record was last updated

key.name: record-monthly
key.description: Highest monthly visitor count from completed periods

key.name: last-notified-monthly
key.description: Last monthly record value that triggered a notification

key.name: last-record-monthly
key.description: Timestamp when the monthly record was last updated

key.name: last-period-daily
key.description: Current daily period key (YYYY-MM-DD)

key.name: last-period-weekly
key.description: Current weekly period key (ISO week start date)

key.name: last-period-monthly
key.description: Current monthly period key (YYYY-MM)

key.name: last-update
key.description: Timestamp of last data refresh

key.name: api-connected
key.description: Whether API has successfully connected and retrieved data
